scope.question: Where can delegated software execution break the principal-to-mandate-to-authorization-to-settlement chain, and what evidence is required to demonstrate detection or intervention value?
in_scope: Construct, label, provenance, and reproducibility audit
Registry and automation attribution separated from fraud
Control-plane, wallet, settlement, entity, market, and outcome evidence
Separate fraud, AML, sanctions, and market-abuse hypotheses
Leakage-safe confirmatory study design and operational safety gates
out_of_scope: Validated fraud or banking performance from the historical snapshot
Deployment thresholds, costs, timelines, or legal conclusions
Autonomy claims without the required evidence-vector conjunction
unresolved_questions: Can an immutable event-complete corpus be released?
Can current wallet, execution, mandate, and outcome evidence be obtained?
Do agent-aware features add lift over incumbent controls on an untouched holdout?

context_gaps: Historical transaction derivatives lost distinct events
No verified autonomous-execution or fraud labels
No banking data or independently adjudicated outcomes

forbidden_estimator_families: Post-hoc test-set optimization presented as confirmatory
forbidden_fit_families: Graph construction or cleaning before the outer split
stop_and_rethink_conditions: The stated construct is not directly observed
The proposed data plane cannot observe the mechanism
A below-chance result receives an unregistered new explanation
An adverse action is proposed without outcome and intervention evidence

observables.name: Historical ERC-8004 registry owner/default-wallet proxy
observables.definition: Historical registry-record (R) association only; W,S,A,C,P,Y,H unknown

observables.name: Mandate-to-settlement evidence
observables.definition: Controller, mandate, provenance, authorization, settlement, and outcome evidence

claims.statement: Unauthorized-loss risk arises when controller mandate, instruction provenance, tool/wallet authorization, or settlement controls fail; automation changes amplification, not the definition of fraud.
The retained historical artifacts permit only exploratory ranking of registry-owner proxies versus unknown counterparties.

deliverables.description: Causal roles, boundaries, planes, mechanisms, and falsifiers
Supported, exploratory, withdrawn, and untested claims

acceptance_tests.subject: claim-causal
acceptance_tests.procedure: Remove or vary each causal element and test whether the explanation loses a distinct mechanism or prediction.
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: Each retained element maps to an observable control point and falsifier.

acceptance_tests.subject: claim-proxy-ranking
acceptance_tests.procedure: Recompute historical metrics and defect counts from identified local artifacts.
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: Machine-readable values match the claim ledger and paper.

acceptance_tests.subject: claim-proxy-ranking
acceptance_tests.procedure: Search authoritative artifacts for fraud, human, autonomy, robustness, banking, or deployment claims unsupported by the required evidence-vector conjunction.
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: Any occurrence is a non-claim, withdrawn history, or future test.

forbidden_proxies.subject: claim-proxy-ranking
forbidden_proxies.proxy: Registry owner treated as verified autonomous agent
forbidden_proxies.reason: R alone does not establish W,S,A,C,P,Y, or H

forbidden_proxies.subject: claim-proxy-ranking
forbidden_proxies.proxy: Unknown counterparty treated as human or legitimate
forbidden_proxies.reason: Comparison labels are not ground truth

forbidden_proxies.subject: claim-causal
forbidden_proxies.proxy: Detector-informed motif sensitivity treated as adversarial robustness
forbidden_proxies.reason: Generator and detector are not independent

forbidden_proxies.subject: claim-causal
forbidden_proxies.proxy: File presence or unit tests treated as scientific validation
forbidden_proxies.reason: Construct and data validity are separate gates

unvalidated_assumptions: Verified autonomous cohorts will exhibit a material model interaction
Mandate/provenance controls will reduce realized loss
competing_explanations: Observed ranking is registry selection or service-type structure rather than autonomy
Existing actor-agnostic controls may already capture the relevant harm
disconfirming_observations: No executor-class interaction on an untouched matched cohort
No incremental lift or harm reduction over incumbent controls
